system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Construct the initial prompt S 0 by concatenating all the tokens in B, s task, and s ICRL.
system_prompt_style.note: Prompt assembled per episode from buffer + task description + instruction; instruction alternates by episode parity (could be read as dynamically_composed).

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Initially, the prompt is only the task description.
env_context_strategy.note: ScienceWorld task description includes environment description and action templates, but no repository/file context.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: Instead, we now make it a deque of length 3. In other words, only the recent 3 episodes are used in constructing S 0.
context_compaction.note: Default buffer is infinite queue (no compaction); short-context deque is a config-reachable ablation.

observation_format.evidence_quote: ScienceWorld (Wang et al., 2022) is an interactive, text-based benchmark

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: The input s task provided to the agent describes the environment, the task, and the template of all possible actions.
tool_call_format.note: Actions are free-text environment commands matching provided templates, not provider tool calls; closest allowed value chosen, mismatch flagged.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: the action space is natural language
edit_primitive.note: No file-editing tool described; tasks are text generation and ScienceWorld commands.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: The input s task provided to the agent describes the environment, the task, and the template of all possible actions.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: we deliberately exclude textual gradients (Yuksekgonul et al., 2025), prioritized experience replay, sampling-based heuristics (Zhang et al., 2024; Yang et al., 2024), or additional engineered modules
protocol_standardization.note: No protocol mention anywhere in repo file tree or paper.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: At each step, the agent observes the result of its action and receives zero reward unless it completes a predefined subgoal.
loop_primitives.note: Default is multi-episode retry loop (Algorithm 1, K episodes) with reward feedback; within ScienceWorld episodes actions/observations alternate.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: To facilitate LLM’s inference time RL, we additionally provide some instructions in initial prompt S 0 at each episode.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: An LLM, denoted as πθ, serves as the policy network.
multi_agent_topology.note: A second LLM call may serve as reward model, but it is an evaluator not an agent.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: An LLM, denoted as πθ, serves as the policy network.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: The only supervision provided is the scalar reward itself.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: We use an experience buffer B to store the LLM’s responses and rewards for the task in previous episodes.
short_term_state.note: Buffer of (action, reward) tuples concatenated into the prompt; arguably structured, but it is re-serialized as context.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Initially, the prompt is only the task description.
long_term_memory.note: Buffer persists across episodes within a run only; no cross-run memory described.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Require: An LLM πθ. A reward function r. Number of episodes K. An experience buffer B.
state_persistence.note: No resume path described in Algorithm 1 or README.

self_verification.evidence_quote: The reward function can be rule-based, learned separately, or instantiated via the same LLM for self-evaluation.
self_verification.note: Default in Game of 24 and creative writing is GPT-4.1 as reward model; ScienceWorld uses environment reward.

retry_policy.note: K episodes, e.g. 50 trials on Game of 24.

rollback.evidence_quote: An episode ends in failure if the agent either reaches the maximum number of steps or executes an incorrect terminating action.
rollback.note: Environment resets between episodes but no rollback of agent-made changes is described.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: An episode ends in failure if the agent either reaches the maximum number of steps or executes an incorrect terminating action.
termination_condition.note: Also episode ends at maximal allowed response length or end-of-sequence token (Sec. 2); outer loop capped at K episodes.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: we evaluate ICRL on Qwen3-32B (Yang et al., 2025) across context lengths of 8k, 16k, and 32k
cost_controls.note: Context-length budget configurable; no caching or routing described.

timeouts.evidence_quote: An episode ends in failure if the agent either reaches the maximum number of steps or executes an incorrect terminating action.
timeouts.note: Limits are step-count based, not time-based; no timeout mentioned.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Clone the ScienceWorld repository and install it
execution_isolation.note: Scripts run locally in a Python venv; ScienceWorld is a local Java-backed simulator.

filesystem_access.note: Agent actions are simulator commands, not filesystem operations; host script itself unrestricted.

network_policy.evidence_quote: We choose the GPT-4.1 model for this experiment because of its excellent long-context capacity (OpenAI, 2025), accessed through api calls.
network_policy.note: No network restriction mechanism anywhere; API calls made from host.

permission_model.evidence_quote: The only supervision provided is the scalar reward itself.
permission_model.note: No authorization layer; actions go straight to the environment.

tracing.evidence_quote: We use an experience buffer B to store the LLM’s responses and rewards for the task in previous episodes.
tracing.note: Trajectories are stored for plotting (plots.ipynb, plots_sci.py) but no structured trace format documented.

replayability.note: README only documents fresh runs; no replay entry point in the file tree.

eval_hooks.note: Repo ships benchmark runners (sciworld.py, llm_game24_api.py, prm_eval.py) reproducing paper results.

guardrails.evidence_quote: we deliberately exclude textual gradients (Yuksekgonul et al., 2025), prioritized experience replay, sampling-based heuristics (Zhang et al., 2024; Yang et al., 2024), or additional engineered modules (Brooks et al., 2024).

target_domain.evidence_quote: We evaluate ICRL prompting on Game of 24, creative writing, ScienceWorld, and Olympiad-level math competitions (AIME and HMMT)
target_domain.note: Domains are text games, creative writing and math; no SWE/web/GUI.

open_source.note: No LICENSE file in the listed file tree; openness inferred from public release statement.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: we tested ICRL on a range of open-source models, including Phi-4 (Abdin et al., 2024), Llama-4 Maverick (AI, 2025), Qwen3-32B

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: This repository contains the code for reproducing the results in the paper "Reward Is Enough: LLMs Are In-Context Reinforcement Learners".
primary_artifact.note: Repo is a paper-artifact snapshot; paper is the primary description.

first_release_date.note: Basis: date of the only tag ('upload') in the pinned repo.

pinned_version.note: Short hash only; full hash not given in evidence.
